title: Actual live-background neutral renewal with degree-preserving output
statement: For the specified two C3 ports/core and fixed positive raw rates,repeat actual I word0123 until its first wrong I source,retaining all D/core paths and the complete competing landing. Hazard-weighted Poisson resolvent/shift identities give mu Q_a<=mu and abort>=c(1+M)^(-14). Thus E L^r,E T^r<=C_r(1+M_in)^(28r),E T<=4 E L/alpha0,and E(1+M_out)^p<=C_p(1+M_in)^p for every fixed p>0.

requires: Corrected common-background mu for all a>=0,including b*c*=sqrt(kb/kf)e*f*;no incoming-law reset. R_a^*(H_a mu)=mu and actual four source shifts have constants with product1.
Programme-accepted physical nonexplosion prerequisite,as supplied. No P3 proof acquisition or new audit of it.
